newsitem.title: USA: IPO VIEW-Holiday brings US IPO flow to standstill.
newsitem.headline: IPO VIEW-Holiday brings US IPO flow to standstill.

text.p: No initial public offerings are currently scheduled for this week, with the approach of the New Year's holiday on Wednesday.

With so many market players absent, underwriters frequently wait until after the holidays to schedule "roadshows." In a roadshow, company officials and investment bankers travel to cities in the United States, and sometimes around the world, to meet with big institutional investors, to drum up demand for the new shares.
The company usually goes public soon after the roadshow.
